facts.text: Combining one hundred site types with many machine models, every season, every speed and every kind of object produces millions of test combinations.
facts.quote: One hundred site types, many machine models, every season, every speed, every kind of object: the combinations run into the millions.

facts.text: Test design selects which test combinations to run.
facts.quote: Test design chooses which ones to run

facts.text: Statistics determines what a set of test results can prove.
facts.quote: statistics says what a set of results can prove.

facts.text: Testing must keep coverage, discovery and estimation streams separate: coverage spreads tests across the test space, discovery deliberately hunts for failures, and estimation uses a frozen random sample to produce an honest number.
facts.quote: Three streams must be kept apart: coverage (spread the tests across the space), discovery (hunt for failures on purpose) and estimation (a frozen random sample that gives an honest number).

facts.text: Mixing coverage, failure-discovery and estimation test streams produces a flattering but false performance number.
facts.quote: Mixing them gives a flattering but false number.

facts.text: False alarms should be counted per hour of real operation, not per staged test.
facts.quote: False alarms are counted per hour of real operation, not per staged test.

facts.text: The validation window after the prototype arrives in mid-2027 is under four months.
facts.quote: The prototype arrives in mid-2027 and the validation window after it is under four months.

facts.text: Documented programs that performed this kind of validation work took years.
facts.quote: The documented programs that did this kind of work took years.

facts.text: The validation timeline only works if the prototype marks the end of preparatory work rather than its start.
facts.quote: The timeline only works if the prototype is the end of the work, not the start.

facts.text: Before the prototype arrives, preparation should complete the scenario catalog, recorded fleet data, virtual sites, sensor and brake models, test benches and operator studies.
facts.quote: build everything before the prototype arrives: the scenario catalog, the recorded fleet data, the virtual sites, the sensor and brake models, the test benches and the operator studies.

facts.text: The post-prototype validation period should be used to correlate models against the real machine, re-run the now-trusted scenario set, confirm the worst cases on a track and run shadow mode.
facts.quote: The four months are then used to correlate the models against the real machine, re-run the now-trusted scenario set, confirm the worst cases on a track, and run shadow mode.

facts.text: Release should be widened only as supporting evidence arrives.
facts.quote: Release is widened only as evidence arrives.

facts.text: Planning the highly uncertain validation schedule requires honest P50 and P80 estimates, gates tied to evidence and a plan that survives hostile review.
facts.quote: Planning under this much uncertainty needs honest estimates (P50 and P80), gates tied to evidence, and a plan that survives a hostile review.
